top_signals.title: Saudi Liquidity Squeeze Adds to Challenges for Crown Prince
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia is grappling with renewed liquidity pressure as the Iran war spurs a pullback in deposits from the government and banks in the United Arab Emirates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Billionaire Jain Bets on Blackstone Deal Driving IIFL’s Growth
top_signals.summary: Blackstone Inc.’s investment in IIFL Finance Ltd. will enable the Indian shadow lender to sustain 25% to 30% annual lending growth over the next three to four years, besides lowering borrowing costs, its billionaire founder Nirmal Jain said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
